description: Every agent's model waterfall from one file (~/.hermes/fleet/models.yaml) — a Home tab of per-card economics, efficiency and the cap and credit clocks; live settings, hosts, prices, token and cache tracking, usage and cost, provider balances, per-model decision logs, an OpenRouter model search on every waterfall, the model chains of apps outside the fleet (BackupBrain, Old Mate), with preview, apply and revert
